items.q: The 1959 milestone on the MN antigen timeline is the:
The 2009 antigen, usually in primary MN, is:
items.exp: 2009: M type PLA2R (usually in primary MN). (Book p768)

items.q: The 2014 antigen, anti-thrombospondin 7A, which can also be seen in secondary MN, is:
items.exp: 2014: THSD7A, anti thrombospondin 7A (can be seen in secondary MN also). (Book p768)

items.q: Match each year with its MN antigens — 1) 2019 2) 2020 3) 2021 … A) Neural cell adhesion molecule 1 (NCAM 1), HTRA-1, contactin-1 B) Exostosin 1/2 C) NELL-1, sema 3b, PCDH7
items.exp: 2019 exostosin 1/2; 2020 NELL-1, sema 3b, PCDH7; 2021 NCAM 1, HTRA-1, contactin-1. (Book p768)

items.q: The 2020 antigen associated with mercury-containing creams is:
items.exp: NELL-1: associated with mercury containing creams. (Book p768)

items.q: The only extrinsic antigen listed in MN is the:
items.exp: Bovine specific antigen: only extrinsic antigen. (Book p768)

items.q: The MN rule of 1/3 divides outcomes into spontaneous remission, CKD and:
opts: Continue heavy proteinuria with normal kidney function
items.exp: 1/3 spontaneous remission; 1/3 continue heavy proteinuria with normal kidney function; 1/3 CKD. (Book p768)

items.q: On light microscopy, MN shows ↑ thickening of capillary wall, described as:
opts: Uniform thickening of glomerular basement membrane
items.exp: Uniform thickening of glomerular basement membrane. (Book p768)

items.q: Match each IF feature with its MN column — 1) 1° MN IgG subclass 2) 2° MN (SLE) IgG subclasses 3) Full house effect … A) + in 2° MN, − in 1° MN B) IgG4 C) IgG1, G2, G3
items.exp: 1° MN: IgG4; 2° MN (SLE): IgG1, G2, G3 with full house +. (Book p768)

items.q: In the IF comparison table, anti PLA2R antibody is positive in 1° MN and negative in 2° MN, while mesangial staining is:
items.exp: Anti PLA2R: − in 2°, + in 1°; mesangial staining: + in 2°, − in 1°. (Book p768)

items.q: On electron microscopy MN shows effacement of podocytes, subepithelial deposits and spikes; 2° MN additionally deposits in the:
items.exp: 2° MN: deposits in both subepithelial space & mesangial space. (Book p768)
